findings.title: Volotea headquarters is conflated with registered address
findings.evidence: Official Impressum states registered address at Asturias Airport, Castrillón, and separately states operational headquarters in Barcelona. Portfolio data calls the registered address its headquarters.
findings.requiredAction: Set headquarters to Barcelona and retain the Castrillón registered address as a separate legal-location fact before import.

findings.title: Research completion and record-level classification overstate evidence
findings.evidence: These records include explicit unresolved headquarters, legal seat, contracting entity, or source-access caveats while all 20 records use researchStatus Researched; the dataset also uses Verified fact alongside hypotheses and unresolved location claims.
findings.requiredAction: Use Needs verification for incomplete records and an accurate record-level evidence classification; preserve individual fact/hypothesis labels.

findings.title: Partial-evidence scores can be mistaken for complete fit or readiness
findings.evidence: The existing score function was independently recalculated and matches every displayed score. It averages 5 of 9 criteria; 4 unknown criteria carry 41.8% of total criterion weight. Scores range 77-100 despite no decision-maker, contract-volume, financial-exposure, or accessibility evidence.
findings.requiredAction: Show 5/9 coverage and all Unknown criteria beside the score. Do not interpret the score as probability, qualification, revenue, or readiness.

findings.title: Avolon and AerCap sequencing is not supported by a stated differentiator
findings.evidence: Both are Dublin-based aircraft lessors, both score 95, and neither has a verified buying contact; Avolon is Priority 1 and AerCap Priority 2.
findings.requiredAction: Treat them as tied first-wave candidates or record a human-reviewed, evidence-based sequencing reason.

findings.title: Detailed provenance is held outside the OCI account schema
findings.evidence: The JSON explicitly identifies records[].assessment and records[].sources as non-account envelopes. The account payload has a free-text source field, but the structured source-to-claim mapping and source confidence are not OCI account fields.
findings.requiredAction: Retain the envelopes in a research/audit artifact or otherwise preserve supported source references before a payload-only import.

findings.title: Portfolio uniqueness does not establish destination uniqueness
findings.evidence: The dataset has 20 distinct names, but no OCI database records were queried and aliases/parent-company relationships were not compared with the authorized destination.
findings.requiredAction: Perform a human-reviewed duplicate check in the authorized OCI environment before import; do not create related contacts or opportunities.

findings.title: No named buying contacts or customer signals were verified
findings.evidence: All contact arrays are empty and stakeholder status is Unknown stakeholder. No buyer access, customer problem, procurement signal, budget, or commitment is evidenced.
findings.requiredAction: Keep these records as targets only. Discover contacts lawfully and qualify opportunities only after customer evidence.

limitations: No customer contracts, internal procurement activity, customer pain, budget, buying signal, buyer access, or willingness to pilot was verified.
Official pages do not consistently provide publication dates; the audit does not infer dates.
Some URLs were blocked or timed out in this retrieval client; that is reported as an access limitation, not as proof of a broken page.
No production database or destination OCI records were accessed; duplicate detection against the eventual import destination remains outstanding.
